_comment: Fragment 99 — B-060: Judge activation approved, Lane B declined it, recorded as LB-S1-03 (D-161). Left absent from the graph by the same G109-class extraction gap as B-058/B-059. Merged 2026-08-30.

nodes.label: Judge Activation Approved and Declined, Recorded as a Review-Only Turn
nodes.description: Lane B raised a recording gap after asserting the Judge had ruled it Active. The Chief Editor confirmed the approval was real but that Lane B itself declined the transition, since the Gap 9 packet was verification work rather than an application-code execution run. D-161 recorded both the approval and the decline, and assigned LB-S1-03 as a review-only turn held without the lock, following the exact LB-S0-02/B-022 precedent rather than inventing a new mechanism.
nodes.rationale: A lane offered activation is not obligated to take it, and declining is not a failure to record — it is a fact worth recording precisely so a docs-only pass is not silently indistinguishable from either an unrun turn or a full execution run. The entry's own premise (an already-applied activation) did not survive the Chief Editor's clarification, and was corrected in place rather than reopened as a fresh error.
